messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Help writing filtering algorithm
parts:
I'd suggest first having a look to see if somebody has already done
the job for you:

https://cran.r-project.org/web/views/

If it turns out you do have to write the code yourself, it might help
to tell us exactly what problems you're encountering in R ("I need to
loop over a list of matrices and find the eigenvalues of each one.
Here's a small example:... . When I run my code, I get: ... . Here
are the details of my R session.")
